architecture.mechanism: Integrated SMC-NADRC robust control using NESO for disturbance compensation and NTD for signal smoothing
architecture.intervention: Replace the existing EPS control algorithm with the proposed integrated SMC-NADRC scheme to compensate for nonlinear friction and parametric uncertainties during high-speed operation and warning states.
architecture.expected_effect: Maintenance of steering assist functionality at highway speeds with minimized tracking errors (under 0.74%) despite system nonlinearities and parameter variations.
architecture.falsification_test: Subject the modified EPS controller to hardware-in-the-loop simulation injecting sudden parametric uncertainty and nonlinear friction spikes at 60 mph equivalent motor speeds; fail if steering column angle RMS tracking error exceeds 1.0% or if assist torque drops below safety threshold.
